newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso firmer on dollar flows to bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso firmer on dollar flows to bourse.

text.p: Mexican peso contracts extended their early advance against the dollar at mid-morning trade on Tuesday due to continued capital inflow to the local bourse, dealers said.
"We can see a real inflow of dollars, in addition to some banks that have decided to shed long dollar positions," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were both trading 3.3 centavos firmer at 7.8520/7.8550 and 7.8490/7.8520 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 2.9 centavos firmer at 7.8470/7.8510 per dollar.
The Mexican bourse had meanwhile gained 80.66 points to 4,670.88 points.
Dealers said they would be attentive for the remainder of the session to Congressional testimony by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
"I feel some players are betting a little on what Greenspan may say later," the dealer added.
